name: @pipeworx/mcp-browserless

tools.name: browserless_content
tools.description: Render a URL in headless Chromium and return the fully-executed HTML (after JavaScript runs) — use this when a plain fetch returns an empty shell or JS-rendered SPA. Example: browserless_content({ url: "https://example.com", _apiKey: "your-token" })

url.description: The page URL to render, e.g. "https://example.com"

waitForTimeout.description: Optional milliseconds to wait after load before capturing HTML (lets late JS settle), e.g. 3000

_apiKey.description: Browserless API token (sign up at https://www.browserless.io/signup)

tools.name: browserless_scrape
tools.description: Extract structured data from a rendered page using CSS selectors. Returns text, inner HTML, attributes and geometry for every matched element. Example: browserless_scrape({ url: "https://news.ycombinator.com", elements: [{ selector: ".titleline a" }], _apiKey: "your-token" })

elements.description: Array of selector objects, each { selector: "<css-selector>" }. Uses document.querySelectorAll, so each selector can match many elements.

_apiKey.description: Browserless API token (sign up at https://www.browserless.io/signup)

tools.name: browserless_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of a rendered page. Returns the image byte-length and metadata only (the binary PNG is NOT inlined). Example: browserless_screenshot({ url: "https://example.com", fullPage: true, _apiKey: "your-token" })

fullPage.description: Capture the entire scrollable page instead of just the viewport (default false)

_apiKey.description: Browserless API token (sign up at https://www.browserless.io/signup)

tools.name: browserless_smart_scrape
tools.description: AI-assisted extraction: tries a plain HTTP fetch first and falls back to a full headless browser, returning content in the requested formats (html, markdown, links, screenshot, pdf). Best when you just want clean page content and do not know the right selectors. Example: browserless_smart_scrape({ url: "https://example.com", formats: ["markdown", "links"], _apiKey: "your-token" })

formats.description: Which formats to return: any of "html", "markdown", "links", "screenshot", "pdf" (default ["html"]). "content" (raw HTML/parsed JSON) is always returned.

_apiKey.description: Browserless API token (sign up at https://www.browserless.io/signup)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-browserless forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the browserless pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
